one_liner.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框上方插入可管理的快捷文本
one_liner.en: Insert and manage reusable snippets above the DSH Web composer

local: Stores entries in $DSH_HOME/quick-input/items.json, or ~/.dsh/quick-input/items.json when DSH_HOME is unset.

install.command: Install the plugin directory from DSH Web Settings → Plugins.

config_items.name: DSH_HOME
config_items.description: Optional DSH home directory used for the quick-input entries file.

completeness.reason: Both the composer picker and snippet management page are implemented, with local persistence.
